Salesforce Snap Pack
The Salesforce Snap Pack gives users a 360-degree visibility of their CRM data. 
Book a Demo
Key Features of the Salesforce Snap Pack
Achieve 360-degree visibility of your CRM data by integrating your e-commerce, customer support, accounting, business intelligence, and custom databases. Expedite your decision-making process by synchronizing all your on-premises and cloud applications alike, while optimizing the customer experience for your customers.
Connect your cloud and on-premises apps, databases, and files in a single SnapLogic pipeline. The Salesforce Snap Pack reads and writes to Salesforce and gives you access to the available objects in Salesforce without requiring additional configuration within Salesforce. In addition, you can insert, update, and upsert object types in Salesforce and populate all the Salesforce data fields for each Salesforce object using the Salesforce Snap Pack. The Snap Pack also supports standard (e.g., Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, and Cases) and custom objects in Salesforce. Using the Snap pack, users can subscribe to Salesforce platform events and change data capture (CDC) topics so that they can act on the changes in the Salesforce data in real-time with minimal overhead.
The Salesforce Snap Pack:
Provides read and write access to Salesforce
Provides access to the available objects in Salesforce
Uses the Salesforce SOAP interface
Does not require additional configuration within Salesforce required for connectivity
Supports standard Salesforce objects (e.g., Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, and Cases)
Supports custom objects created in Salesforce
Provides read, insert, update, and upsert capabilities for Salesforce object types that support them
Populates all the Salesforce data fields for each Salesforce object
Allows users to subscribe to Salesforce platform events and change data capture (CDC) topics
Supports bulk operations with Bulk API 2.0
The Salesforce Snap Pack supports the following operations on Salesforce objects:
Attachment Download
Batch Create
Bulk (Create, Delete, Upsert, Update, Query)
Create
Read
Platform Events (Subscriber and Publisher)
Lookup
Poller
SOQL
SOSL
Update
Upsert
Delete
Wave Analytics
Learn more about the Salesforce Snap Pack in the product documentation.
